games.summary: Fast-paced 1v1 street soccer arcade game! Control unique heroes, use spectacular combat-style moves, and defeat opponents in real-time. Upgrade your characters' skills, conquer global leagues, and become a superstar in thrilling online PvP football matches

games.name: Apple Catcher
games.summary: Use your webcam to control the action in Apple Catcher, a colorful motion-controlled arcade game. Lean left and right to move your basket, catch apples, avoid sticks, clear increasingly challenging levels, and chase a high score in Endless Mode.

games.name: Aquarium Days
games.summary: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

games.name: Artificial Ambition
games.summary: Grow your AI startup from a 2017 garage to an industry titan. Hire specialists, train models, and outsmart rivals. Build the future, but tread carefully—your relentless drive for progress might just open a Pandora's box of unintended power.

games.name: Ashen Legacy
games.summary: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

games.name: ASTERIS
games.summary: Claim divine power in ASTERIS, an action roguelite for solo play and up to 4-player online co-op. Build your skills anew each run, master four heroes, and conquer bosses with tank, damage, and healing roles. Keep your gear and permanent growth for the next challenge.

games.name: Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Boys
games.summary:
In public, their lives look perfect.
Tailored suits, quiet fortunes, and men who always seem in control.

Behind closed doors, things are different.
A handshake that lasts a moment longer than it should.
A private message sent late at night.
A man who built an empire on keeping secrets… and is about to trust you with his.

In Billionaire Secret Affair: Forbidden Desire Boys, you enter an adult story about attraction between men who can't afford to be seen, and the connection that grows anyway.

These are men with names to protect. Investors, heirs, and founders who learned early that every feeling has a cost. Getting close means reading what they don't say and offering the honesty they never find anywhere else.

Every choice matters. A careful word can open a door they've kept locked for years. A careless one can send them back behind the mask for good.

Closeness grows in small, private moments. A drink after everyone leaves. A confession nobody else hears. The feeling of finally being chosen.

As the days pass, the pressure builds, reputations hang in the balance, and each man has to decide what he's willing to risk. Not every path ends in love, and not every story ends the same way.

A visual novel about desire, discretion, and the courage it takes to want someone out loud.

games.name: Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Girls
games.summary:
Powerful women. Private rules. A secret only you can keep.

From the outside, their world looks untouchable.
Glass penthouses, private galas, and women who never lose their composure.

But power has its cracks.
A look that stays on you a little too long.
An invitation nobody else received.
A smile that says she's used to getting what she wants… and tonight, that might be you.

In Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Girls, you're pulled into an adult story about attraction, discretion, and the price of getting too close to the wrong person.

These women run companies, fortunes, and reputations. They don't do anything by accident. Catching their attention is one thing. Keeping it without getting burned is another.

Every conversation is a test. Say too much and the door closes. Say too little and someone else takes your place. The right words at the right moment can turn a polite exchange into something neither of you can talk about in public.

Trust is earned slowly, in stolen moments and conversations that end before anyone notices.

games.name: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
games.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

games.name: BREACHCAM
games.summary:
EVERY BREACH IS RECORDED

BREACHCAM puts you behind the lens of a body camera worn into the fight. There is nothing clean between you and what happens: the picture bends at the edges, the sensor grains up in the dark, the frame swings with every step, and the recording marker never leaves the corner.

SIX PLACES, SIX MOODS

A hangar and a yard in flat daylight. Abandoned streets under a grey sky. Container stacks at sunset. A forest road in fog. Rail tracks and tankers in the snow at dawn. A warehouse of racks and catwalks at night.

Each one is its own deployment, with its own light, weather and layout, and you choose where to go.

CLOSE AND LOUD

You arrive carrying everything you need — rifles, a shotgun, a sidearm, grenades and a blade — so the fight starts the moment you step in. Enemy squads hold the ground, take cover and push you back when you let them, and the whole thing plays out in seconds at a distance you can measure in steps.

A RECORDING, NOT A REPORT

No maps, no markers, no briefings. Just the camera, the room in front of you, and whatever the lens catches.

games.name: Build the Hole
games.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

games.name: Cabinet Fever
games.summary: Run an arcade from 1972 to 1998. Buy cabinets, set the prices, keep them repaired and play every one of the 31 machines yourself: each is a real, playable game. Grow from a corner nook into a neon megaplex as the years roll by.

games.name: Captive 3000
games.summary: Old-school sci-fi first-person real-time dungeon crawler. Grid-based movement. Traditional sprite design. Inspired by classic 'blobber' games like Dungeon Master, Eye of the Beholder, and the Amiga/Atari masterpiece Captive.

games.name: Card Slay
games.summary: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Chase the flush, sweat the last discard, then slam it down and watch the damage hit: red suits strike, black suits shield. The monsters read your hand, call your ranks and cheat, so stack your ritual deck, out-cheat them, and slay your fate.

games.name: Cash is King! - The Official Book
Cat Caffeine
games.summary: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Serve customers and decorate your café while you work or relax.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced Action Roguelite that combines frantic combat, precision platforming and unique builds across procedurally generated planets. Every run offers new ways to play, death is permanent. Can you survive the cat-astrophe?

games.name: Catnigma
games.summary:
Steal fish in the most magical and sneaky way possible!

Catnigma is a magical puzzle game where you control a flying cat on a quest to satisfy its endless hunger for fish. The cat moves continuously in the chosen direction until it hits an obstacle, and it’s up to you to use your wits and magical tricks to collect every fish in the level.

Once you’ve gathered them all, return to the Magic Box to unlock the next challenge!
With a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere, original music, and enchanting visuals, each stage feels like exploring a quiet, nighttime home.

Search every corner: living room, kitchen, and bedroom – no fish is safe from your magical cat!

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Circuit Puzzle - Brain Training: Connect the Wires -
games.summary:
Rotate the tiles. Complete the circuit!

Can you bring a scrambled circuit back to life?

Remember those simple puzzles that looked easy until you tried them? This time, a circuit board is your playground in a satisfying rotation puzzle that is easy to learn and tricky to master.

Rotate tiles covered with wires until every connection lines up correctly. One turn at a time, restore the circuit and watch the electronic board come together.

How to play:
• Observe the circuit board design
• Rotate the tiles to change their direction
• Connect the wires correctly and complete the circuit

The rules are simple, but finding the right direction takes careful observation and a spark of intuition. Seeing scattered wires join into a complete circuit delivers a wonderfully satisfying finish.

Whether you enjoy testing your focus and problem-solving skills or just want a quick brain-training break, this puzzle is a welcoming choice for beginners and experienced players alike.

Rotate each tile and bring the circuit back to life!

games.name: Coverage
games.summary: A board game for two players similar to games like Othello and Ataxx. Cover the board with your pieces--or take over all of your opponent's.

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
games.summary: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

games.name: Cuby Clicker
games.summary: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

games.name: Curiosity Kills
games.summary: Curiosity is what gets you in. Teamwork is what gets you out. Explore a forgotten research facility as a crew of curious monkeys: haul loot, dodge horrors, grind monsters, unlock wild cosmetics, and survive together. Free-to-play co-op horror in VR and on flat screen.

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary:
Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets... and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case... until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

games.name: DeepCorp Rescue
games.summary: DeepCorp Rescue is a physics-based arcade rescue game where you pilot a fragile rocket through dangerous caves, dodge traps, save workers, recover cargo, and land safely. Upgrade your ship, master tricky missions, and survive DeepCorp’s hazardous underground world.

games.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
games.summary: Wildly satisfying incremental shooter! Gun down desktop bugs, farm resources to upgrade skill trees, and wield wild weapons like flamethrowers & exorcism cameras. Total stress buster for quick work breaks! Perfect casual stress relief game for your breaks.

games.name: Desktop Fireworks Festival
games.summary: Desktop Fireworks Festival is a management game where your desktop becomes the venue for your very own fireworks festival. Grow your festival into a grand venue and fill your desktop sky with a spectacular fireworks display of your own!

games.name: Diamonds and Spades
games.summary: At first glance, Diamonds and Spades looks like a simple card game. But then you discover powerful combos and achieve absurdly high scores. Collect unique Tarot cards with special abilities and create your own cards in the editor.

games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
games.summary: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: DriveGear
games.summary: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

games.name: Dungeon of Dragon Knight Remake
games.summary:
Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake
Step into a forgotten dungeon, where the echoes of ancient wars still linger. The legend of the Dragon Knight lies buried beneath its stones—and so does the Artifact that once kept the darkness at bay.

Classic Dungeon Crawling, Reborn
Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake is a first-person, grid-based, real-time combat dungeon crawler RPG that faithfully revives the essence of classic old-school dungeon exploration. Navigate each corridor step by step, feel the tension of every corner, and strike fast in real-time combat.

Build Your Party
Assemble a four-person adventuring party from a variety of classes and races. Each character brings unique abilities and growth paths, and every choice you make shapes your party’s combat style and exploration strategy.

Exploration and Puzzles Intertwined
This dungeon is not just a battleground—it is a massive puzzle box. Hidden switches, ancient carvings, scattered letters… every detail may hold the key to the next floor, or reveal a secret long buried beneath the stone.

The Dragon Knight’s Legacy
Legend says the Dragon Knight used the Artifact to seal the darkness beneath the dungeon. Now the Artifact is stolen, and the darkness is rising. Lured into the dungeon by a witch, you must find the Artifact before the dungeon claims you—and uncover the truth before it is lost forever.

games.name: DYTH
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder about collecting dice and climbing a tower. Place dice against enemies, combine numbers and elements to form hands and trigger Resonance, and modify your dice through battles and events. Plan your route with the dice you have left.

games.name: EGGCONSOLE Harry Fox MSX Special MSX
games.summary:
A mother fox's touching story now features 2D map exploration, 3D dungeons, and RPG combat. More than a port, it feels brand-new!

This title is an adventure game originally released by Microcabin in 1986. While retaining the touching core story—a mother fox setting off toward the distant Reel Shrine in search of fried tofu (abura-age), rumored to be a miracle cure for her terminally ill kit—this unique MSX arranged port drastically overhauls the original gameplay systems.

The game has evolved into a deeply engaging, RPG-like experience. Controls have been updated to a user-friendly, command-selection menu, allowing players to freely explore a 2D scrolling world map. The addition of perspective-shifting 3D dungeon exploration further enhances the sense of immersion.

Free movement across the map brings a substantial increase in narrative content along the journey. Alongside traditional RPG elements such as health points (HP) and battles against wild animals, a dynamic day-night cycle has been introduced. This makes room for numerous new side quests and events, including time-sensitive occurrences, conversations with quirky animal inhabitants, and requests from NPCs.

While faithfully preserving the gentle, heartwarming atmosphere of the original fairy-tale fantasy, the integration of open exploration, combat, and varied events turns it into a livelier, action-oriented adventure. Transcending the boundaries of a standard port, this charming classic offers a fresh experience that feels almost entirely brand-new.

games.name: Endless Shift: Haunted House
games.summary: A cozy Halloween restaurant game! You're the ghost waiter of a haunted hotel: seat vampires, mummies and werewolves, serve potions and monstrous dishes, and dress up in Halloween costumes, all before their patience runs out!

games.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
games.summary: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a unified 4v4 team sport. Across shared middle ranks, pieces migrate between boards to flank opponents and save teammates. A true multi-board competitive variant built to completely revolutionize the team chess format!

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

games.name: ESCAPE SHOW
games.summary: A game show where eight people are locked in identical rooms and only one knows the way out — and that person is not allowed to speak. Read the master's mime, finish the tasks, raid your neighbour's room, and get out before the gas. Best played shouting.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: False Feed
games.summary: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different perspectives in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: Find & Collect: Cats Edition
games.summary: Try to find the “cat” hidden somewhere! If the “cat” is hard to find, you can color it in to make it easier to spot! Just find the “cat,” and the “Cat Encyclopedia” will be unlocked!

games.name: FlipFlip Jigsaw DOUBLE-SIDE PUZZLE
games.summary:
Clear Both Sides♪ A New Double-Sided Flip Puzzle Featuring a Variety of Illustrations!

In addition to classic jigsaw puzzle gameplay, challenge yourself with a unique puzzle experience combining Rotate and Flip mechanics!
Featuring a variety of illustrations, including cute girls and adorable animals♪ Take your time, enjoy the artwork, and complete each puzzle at your own pace!
15 stages included!
As you progress, new mechanics and larger piece counts increase the challenge!
• Stages 1–5: Rotate Puzzles
• Stages 6–10: Double-Sided Flip Puzzles
• Stages 11–15: Double-Sided Flip + Rotate Puzzles
• Includes high-difficulty stages with up to 81 pieces × 2 sides!
In double-sided stages, you can complete either the front side or the back side first! How you solve each puzzle is entirely up to you♪
The final stage is an ultimate challenge with no background watermark hints! Carefully examine every piece and work your way toward completion!
A gallery featuring both front-side and back-side artwork is unlocked as you complete puzzles! Clear every stage and complete the entire gallery collection!

games.name: Floaterra
games.summary: Build and expand a floating settlement in Floaterra, a single-player farming and automation game. Grow crops, craft machines, organize production, and put robot helpers to work, with your RoboPet at your side.

games.name: Futbolero: Football Career Simulator
games.summary: Eternal idol or washed-up talent? Futbolero blends a football career sim, choice-driven roguelite, and key arcade minigames. Every run is a new life: from the streets to glory, juggling contracts, parties, and dynasties. Play solo or with friends in co-op or competitive PvP.

games.name: Gemporium
games.summary:
Mine, refine, and sell gemstones in Gemporium, a cute, fast-paced shop management game.

Grow your small gem business in this short, casual simulation miner, Gemporium! Manage your time wisely between mining gemstones, refining them for more profit, and selling them to awaiting customers. After your Grandmole goes on vacation, you’re in charge of running her shop, and you quickly learn it also comes with a price of massive debt. Now, on top of building your business, you must appease the Loan Shark without going broke!

Gemporium features a timed day cycle where you have to balance completing tasks and running the gem store. Each day consists of:

Mining
Explore deeper and deeper in the local mines to stock up on gems of different rarities. Utilize various mining tools to prevent cracks and maintain the highest quality product for your shop!

Refining
Polish and prepare your recent finds in the mine to convert those lumps of rock into something collectors adore! Unrefined gemstones sell for way less than their refined counterparts, so make sure to visit the refinement table before you set up shop.

games.name: GeoJelly
games.summary:
Born within unknown you instinctively seek for freedom as an experiment defect. 

In GeoJelly you have to find your way out of dystopian laboratory through platforming while avoiding traps and collecting keys necessary to push forward. 

Are you gonna find a way out?

games.name: GET FIT - Street Workout
games.summary:
Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine - then jump into 30 minutes of intense full-body workout.

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

games.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
games.summary: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

games.name: Green Gas

Work together to gather money and power the main Generator to survive But the Cancer hides among you, stealing cash, spreading toxic gas or water setting deadly traps and contaminating rooms Trapped? Win the mini‑game or die!

games.name: Grim Guild
games.summary: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back.

games.name: GrindFall
games.summary: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

games.name: Guided Meditations - Calm Mind
games.summary:
Relax and quiet your mind with soothing, voice-guided meditations. Settle in, and be guided to a more peaceful place.

Take a moment for yourself. Guided Meditations brings calming, voice-led meditation to your console — a peaceful space to relax, de-stress, and reconnect with a quieter mind, whether you have ten minutes or twenty.

No experience needed. Just pick a session, choose your setting, and let a warm, soothing voice guide you gently through every breath. Sink into tranquil visuals and softly flowing ambient sound, designed to ease away the noise of the day.

Whether you're winding down before sleep, settling a busy mind, or simply carving out a little calm in your routine, this is your invitation to slow down and just be.

Features

Soothing voice-guided meditations for all experience levels
Two calming guide voices to choose from
Shorter and longer sessions to fit your time
Beautiful, tranquil backgrounds you can select
Gentle ambient music to deepen your calm
A simple, peaceful experience — sit back, breathe, and unwind

Find your calm, one breath at a time.

games.name: GuruGuru Cannon
games.summary: GuruGuru Cannon is a fast-paced 2D swinging action score attack game that delivers satisfying gameplay with intuitive controls. Use simple one-button controls to send the ball flying across the field! Score as many points as possible within 60 seconds!

games.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
games.summary: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

games.name: Hazzard Hearth
games.summary: Survive the known (hunt, craft, fish, treat illness, mend bones, ration supplies, wolves, bears) and unknown (volatile weather, mutated beasts), stranded on a mountain. Solve the mystery and try to re-establish communications for rescue. Free roam or follow the story. Play single player or co-op.

games.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator: Heavy Defense
Hidden Cats in Beijing
games.summary: Explore Beijing and find over 840 hidden objects, including cats and characters. Find Special Cats, unlock 7 bonus stages with two coloring modes, and collect cards featuring Beijing landmarks and real cats from our community.

games.name: Hide & Hue
games.summary:
Paint to blend in, freeze, and hide — or switch sides and hunt.

Paint yourself. Freeze. Hope they walk past.
You are a small blank doll in a room full of colour. The seekers are on their way, and the only thing standing between you and a finger pointed at your head is the paint you put on your own body.
Every round is three moments.
Prepare. Grab a colour and paint yourself — panel by panel, or the whole doll at once. A palette of 48 shades is always at hand, and the eyedropper lifts the exact colour off a wall, a chair, a crate or the floor right beside you. Pick a pose — stand, sit, or curl into a ball — and squeeze in wherever a tall doll would never fit. Lock your body when you like the spot, so a nudge can't ruin it.
Hide. The seekers spread out and start searching. They look along their line of sight, get suspicious of anything that stands out, and close in to be sure. A good colour match buys you seconds of doubt. A bad one gets you caught standing in plain sight.
The result. Survive and you earn up to three stars — for how well your colour matched the place you chose, not just for hanging on. Get caught and the round starts over instantly, so you can go straight back in with a better idea.
Or turn it around and be the one searching. Choose to play as the seeker, wait while the hiders paint and tuck themselves away, then go find them. Walk up, look closely, and mark every doll you spot before the clock runs out. Clever hiders match the wall exactly and pick the darkest corner — careless ones give themselves away with the wrong shade.
Five places to disappear in.

games.name: HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
games.summary: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

games.name: HOLLOWSIM: Industrial Voidline Defense
games.summary: A retro-styled space strategy and simulation game where you build, defend, and expand an industrial foothold in a hostile sector. Manage ships, structures, resources, and escalating threats as you grow from a fragile station into a resilient operation.

games.name: Hoof Trimmer Simulator
games.summary: Clean, pare and treat sore cow hooves in a cozy barn. Scrape off the crust, carve satisfying horn curls, find the abscess with hoof testers and release the pressure — then watch your patient walk away sound. Nine breeds, endless cases, oddly satisfying.

games.name: Hyakui Pan
games.summary: Imagine you own this fancy beauty salon and you have to prove your talents by changing this girl's look the way you want. Begin with her hairstyle and hair color, use some makeup on her face, eyes and lips and then pick up a cute shirt to dress her up. Don't forget to also choose some accessories to complete her chic look! Enjoy!Game Instructions / ControlsUse the finger to drag and drop the hair tools and the clothes, and to click on the make up items to change the girl's look.Good Luck!

games.name: Impossible Draw
games.summary:
-==TAKE A TRANQUILIZING TRIP INTO CYBERSPACE==-

Mimic the signs of virtuality to progress through a world where colors, shapes and music forms an ecstatic atmosphere. Draw symbols, collect bytes and enjoy the hypnotic mix of audiovisual harmony!

Test your drawing skills, while your mind will be carried to an ever-changing computer space made from relaxing elements. Impossible Draw was built upon the basic concept that even the world's most trivial looking symbol can be challenging if you try to draw it accurately. If you're up to the challenge, Impossible Draw rewards your efforts with various unlockable extras, which makes it an even deeper, dream-like experience. Customize your trips (as you try to master your skills) with various game modes, special effects and soundtracks. Therefore, every replay could be a unique experience.

games.name: In Mutable Form - The Making and Philosophy of The Bull of Heaven
Isle Of Thundir
games.summary: Explore the world, Discover Villages, Build a magnificent fortress and defeat your enemies in battle. Command troops and administer their needs. Defend your fort well or lose everything.

games.name: JapaneseDialect
games.summary: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

games.name: Junkyard Reseller
games.summary: Choose an AWESOME BLOCK MAN and race your way through the streets!! Be careful you don't crash into the Harlem Shakers, SCARY zombies, stick men and the ninjas....!!!!!!!!

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kemonomimi Territory
games.summary: There’s only room for one kemonomimi tribe on the island. Recruit your army, claim hexes and capture rival bases to be the last tribe standing. Play this single-player, turn-based virtual board game in VR or on desktop.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: LightQb
games.summary: Dash and survive in a grid-like world filled with colored light cubes, lasers, and portals, each with unique mechanics. Play, die, and repeat to master the fastest path to the finish. Time is not on your side.

games.name: Lil Laundry Lane
games.summary: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

games.name: Lilac ~side Witch~
games.summary:
A fantasy visual novel set in a magic school where humans and mages mingle. Follow Emil, a young human who despises mages, and Henri, a self-proclaimed "bonehead" of a mage, as they learn how to connect in spite of various anxieties and differing backgrounds.

Features numerous beautiful characters designed by industry veteran Oyari Ashito!

The female main cast version ("Lilac -side Witch-") and the male main cast version ("Lilac -side Wizard-") contain different characters and voices. There are also small details unique to each story version.

games.name: Lilac ~side Wizard~
games.summary:
This is a tale of how mages and humans learn to connect.


A fantasy visual novel set in a magic school where humans and mages mingle. Follow Emil, a young human who despises mages, and Henri, a self-proclaimed "bonehead" of a mage, as they learn how to connect in spite of various anxieties and differing backgrounds.
Features numerous beautiful characters designed by industry veteran Oyari Ashito!


Lilac Academy.
A joint magic school established by Lilac, the Legendary Magus, who wished for a world where humans and mages could come together, hand in hand, in peace and harmony.
One day, in a rural village in the east, an admission letter arrives at the home of a sick mother and her child, Emil.
Having been treated badly by a mage in the past, Emil hates mages. However, upon learning that graduating from the academy would net a generous monetary reward, Emil resolves to enroll. The reason? Family comes before any grudge.
After getting lost on the way to the academy, Emil meets Henri, who happens to be around the same age. The two hit it off, but that all falls apart once Emil realizes that Henri is actually a mage.
Disgusted at this revelation, Emil tries to leave, but Henri insists on showing the way to the academy and forcibly casts a spell.
However, the spell fails, and Emil is sent flying to an unfamiliar place. Thus begins Emil's turbulent academy life.

games.name: LINE WARLORD
games.summary: A real-time line-battle roguelite. Spend rations to summon swordsmen, shields, archers and cavalry onto a single front, then break the enemy base. Pick relics and promotions at every fork to build a different army each run. Three commanders, three ultimates.

games.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
games.summary: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!

games.name: Love Joy Happiness
games.summary: Short incremental game about things that are important in your life.

games.name: Love n Life: Happy Student - Winter Embrace
Magic Ball Sort
games.summary: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

games.name: Make it! Karaage
games.summary: Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge! Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!

games.name: Mallet Mayhem '84
games.summary: Step up to a colourful 1980s arcade table in Mallet Mayhem '84. Guide your mallet with the mouse, line up bank shots, face three AI difficulty levels, or challenge a Steam friend in private online 1v1. Play best-of-three matches from two camera views.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
games.summary: Grow, nurture and sell exquisite flowers from your own shop in old France. Plant seeds, tend each bloom with care, master dozens of species, and build a thriving florist as customers come seeking the perfect bouquet — all in first person, at your own peaceful pace.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary:
The critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch 2.

Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.

games.name: Math Time
games.summary: 45 seconds, 15 questions, one rival. Math Time is a fast 1v1 math duel: race real players or quirky math machines, pick the right answer from three choices and climb the leaderboard. Daily quests, day streaks and friend duels keep you coming back.

games.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
games.summary: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

games.name: Monster Club League Manager
games.summary: Take charge of a monster club and aim for the Division 1 title in this single-player management sim. Recruit and develop players, choose a nine-monster lineup, and manage contracts, transfers, and club finances. Matches play out automatically as you build your squad over many seasons.

games.name: Moon Swarm
games.summary: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

games.name: Moto Rogue
games.summary: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

games.name: Needle In A Haystack 2026
games.summary:
Pull the straws. Sell the hay. Hire a crew, grab a rake. Find the needle in the haystack!

Somewhere in this haystack there is a needle. Your job is to find it, one straw at a time.

Needle In A Haystack 2026 is a relaxing first-person idle game set in a huge factory hall. Grab straws from the pile, drop them on the conveyor belt and watch the money roll in. Every straw you sell brings you closer to the needle hidden deep inside the stack.

Start small with your bare hands and the little Backyard Stack. Spend your earnings in the Workshop to carry more straws at once, get a better price for every straw and hire workers who dig through the hay while you search for the needle. When you are ready, take on The Great Haystack - a towering dome of more than 26,000 straws.

UPGRADE YOUR TOOLS
- Bigger hands: carry more straws on every trip
- Better buyer: earn more money for every straw
- Rake: sweep up a whole bunch of straws with one stroke
- Vacuum cleaner: suck straws straight out of the pile
- Metal detector: scan through the hay and listen for the needle. At the top level, an arrow points the way

games.name: Neuville Survivors
games.summary: Play a Survival game that combines Exploration and Tower Defense, and discover why on Neuville, the AI does not want humans on the planet.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Nie Xiaoqian
games.summary: Nie Xiaoqian is a supernatural visual novel set in ancient China. At a ruined temple in Jinhua, scholar Ning Caichen meets a trapped young ghost. Grow closer through doubt, trust and mortal danger. Shape their story with key choices, explore different endings, and find where they belong.

games.name: Nino: the Persuader
games.summary: A narrative strategy game about words, power, and consequence. Play as Nino: a persuader navigating six rival nations where every dialogue choice shifts the balance of trust, faith, and hostility across an entire world.

games.name: Nonet Concerto R
games.summary: Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and battle monsters with a wide range of spells in this third-person, loot-driven 3D action game. Experiment with different builds across more than 50 stages, solo or in online co-op with up to four players.

games.name: Not My Son
games.summary: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

games.name: Novalex Project Zero
games.summary: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

games.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
Parasite: Among the Guests
games.summary: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.

games.name: Penguin Colony (Broanater)
games.summary: Send your penguins waddling off to gather pebbles, fish the Shore and grow a bustling colony. Buy upgrades until the whole flock works on its own, then Migrate for Feathers and come back stronger. A cosy incremental game with a real ending, and an Endless mode if you never want to stop.

games.name: Phantom Floor
games.summary:
You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. 

You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

games.name: Play & Learn My First Korean
games.summary:
See it. Fill in Hangul!

Can you recognize the right Korean word from a picture and its meaning?

If you are just starting out, learning a new language can feel intimidating. This game makes your first steps into Korean simple and fun.

Complete Korean words by filling in the blank with the correct Hangul. Illustrations and Japanese meanings help you understand familiar everyday words as you play.

How to play:
• Check the illustration and the Japanese meaning.
• Choose the correct Hangul from the answer choices.
• Complete the Korean word in the blank.

With 120 stages to play, you can gradually get used to Hangul letters and Korean vocabulary through a fun game-like experience.

Recommended for anyone who:
• Wants to start learning Korean
• Wants to learn Hangul in a fun way
• Wants to get familiar with Korean words
• Enjoys quizzes and fill-in-the-blank puzzles
• Wants to practice a language in short sessions

games.name: PlayASM
games.summary: Build a computer from the inside out. Write real assembly, watch every register and byte change live, then draw graphics, compose chiptune music, program a robot arm and build 3D voxel worlds. 100+ missions. Full mod support. No black boxes.

games.name: Primary School - English Grade 2
games.summary:
A full year of English adventures! Join 7 lovable characters, blast through countless topics, ace every quiz and become an English superstar.

Make learning English feel easy, structured, and fun. With 7 lovable characters, kids explore the full Grade 2 curriculum through guided lessons, interactive quizzes, and friendly explanations. Smart progress tracking and spaced repetition help strengthen long-term memory. Perfect for parents and children learning together — or for confident young learners practicing independently.

games.name: PROPERTY INSPECTION
games.summary: Property Inspection is a short first-person psychological horror game about completing a routine inspection of Unit 47. Examine the apartment, document structural issues, follow your checklist, and finish the job when the final task stops making sense.

games.name: Psychotrons
games.summary: Psychotrons is a point and click in the wake of Monkey Island, there is no game over. 90+ challenges/screens where the player collects Lost Neurons and convinces the Psychotrons to give up them engaging in absurd conversation. There is no graphic violence and it is a full OFF-LINE game.

games.name: Puppet of Pain
games.summary:
Aim, shoot, throw, explode and laugh! Hit the silly puppet target with crazy weapons and funny reactions!

Welcome to the craziest carnival shooting gallery ever! Puppet of Pain is a hilarious action game where a hanging puppet swings in front of you, ready for nonstop chaos.

Take aim and hit the moving dummy with an enormous collection of wild weapons. Every shot, throw, or explosion makes the puppet wobble, spin, bounce, and react with funny screams, groans, and ridiculous sounds that make every hit even more entertaining.

Unlock a massive arsenal of weapons:

Pistols, rifles and machine guns
Shotguns, launchers and bazookas
Knives and other sharp throwing weapons
Fire-based weapons and explosives
Magic staves and cursed powers
Bows, crossbows and fantasy gear
Sci-fi lasers and energy blasters
Crazy surprise weapons

Every hit earns coins, allowing you to unlock even more tools of destruction.

games.name: Pushlings
games.summary: Pushlings is a competitive multiplayer game where players compete to accumulate the highest number of points through movement. Each step counts toward the score, while enemies appear throughout the match and other players compete for space by pushing each other.

games.name: Quiver Story
games.summary: You are the last archer of the Quiver Watch. Hold the line, charge your shot, and put down what the mountain sends before it reaches the village.

games.name: Ragdoll Robotics
games.summary: Ragdoll Robotics is a physics puzzle game packed with explosive chain reactions. Place mines, spikes, launchers and turrets, send your robot through the test chamber, and refine your setup to beat each level’s challenge.

games.name: Retail Nation: My Supermarket
games.summary: Build, customize and manage your own supermarket in this first-person retail simulation. Order stock, fill shelves, serve customers, manage and develop employees, and grow a small shop into a thriving supermarket.

games.name: Revenant : In Memory Of The Day
games.summary: You are heading down an endless corridor in search of a missing child. Pay close attention to your surroundings to find clues about the child, and find a way to escape the dark, confined corridor.

games.name: Rules of the Inn
games.summary: You know the rules. You still can't be sure what you just saw was real. A room in an inn on the border of the afterlife; each night, another rule. What comes for you is drawn fresh - no two nights are alike. Lower your eyes, cover your ears, judge the wrongness. Judge wrong, and morning never comes.

games.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
games.summary:
Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

Key Features:
• Meet and interact with multiple android heroines, each with a unique design, traits, and branching storylines.
• Navigate romantic, dramatic, and suspenseful storylines by making impactful decisions.
• A blend of visual novel intimacy and sci-fi adventure.
• An immersive, futuristic world inspired by cyberpunk romance and emotional AI testing.

games.name: Seashells & Shovels
games.summary: Volunteer to clean tourist islands and seize the chance to hunt pirate treasure. Sail between 12 colorful islands, bag litter, scrub away paint, follow maps, dig up buried finds, and make your ship a home in a cozy first-person adventure.

games.name: Shardwatch Dominion
games.summary: Build and upgrade towers to defend your crystal fortress from endless waves of enemies in this classic circular tower defense game. Strategic placement and powerful upgrades are key to survival.

games.name: Shelterra the Skyworld
games.summary: Explore a floating continent in a fantasy JRPG! Journey across an open world, conquer dungeons in turn-based battles, learn new skills by fighting enemies, and summon powerful Artifacts to aid you. Uncover the secrets of the Skyworld and save Shelterra from falling!

games.name: Shove Nova
games.summary: Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D physics arena game where you grow your energy sphere, use powerful abilities, and smash rivals out of a shrinking battlefield. Master chaotic arenas filled with portals, black holes, bounce walls, and other hazards as you fight to be the last one standing.

games.name: Slay the Tire
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder on two wheels. Choose one of four outlaws, build your deck, collect powerful gas cans, and battle across America's back roads. Every turn becomes a cinematic motorcycle chase through deserts, bayous, cities, and coastal storms.

games.name: Sleepless Night Mysteries: Unsolved Case Files
games.summary:
Can you crack these mysteries?

What secrets are waiting at the scene?

If you enjoy detective stories but want something easy to pick up, this mystery game lets anyone feel like a real investigator.

Search through unsolved cases, uncover hidden evidence, and piece together what really happened. Every case is a self-contained short story, so you can enjoy a complete mystery whenever you have a little time.

• Examine each scene carefully
• Find the evidence hidden in the case
• Use hints when you need a helping hand
• Follow the clues and reveal the truth

Helpful hints make the game welcoming for newcomers to mysteries and deduction, while careful observers can test their skills from the very first case.

Enjoy a quick mystery break, challenge your powers of observation, and try to solve each case before the answer comes to light!

games.name: Sora - Oasis Treasures
games.summary:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago. 

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight. 
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together. 

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

games.name: Sort Them Fish
games.summary: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

games.name: Soul Snake 3D
games.summary: Slither through seven cursed biomes as a snake that grows into a weapon. Eat prey, auto-fire venom darts, and build a run from 68 upgrade cards and 9 evolutions. Topple each biome's guardian, bank souls for permanent upgrades, and see how long you last in endless Survival.

games.name: Spice Pound
games.summary: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

games.name: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The future of humanity is balanced on the edge of a blade. Ravaged by strange, powerful creatures, Earth has been abandoned, and what is left of the decimated human race has fled to a Colony in outer space.

After travelling from the Colony, EVE arrives on the desolate remains of our planet with a clear-cut mission: to save humankind by reclaiming Earth from the Naytiba - the malevolent force that has devastated it.

But as EVE tackles the Naytiba one-by-one, piecing together the mysteries of the past in the ruins of human civilization, she realizes that her mission is far from straightforward. In fact, almost nothing is as it seems...

Engage in blisteringly fast combat as you slash a path through the remnants of Earth. Unleash graceful yet brutal attacking combos, unlock new moves and weapon upgrades, and face epic boss encounters that will challenge both brain and brawn in equal measure.

Unravel a gripping human fate story, with mature themes, a thought-provoking narrative and emotionally-charged revelations from beginning to end.

games.name: StoneEra
games.summary: Build, manage, and expand a medieval voxel colony in a procedurally generated world. Gather resources, assign AI-controlled villagers, reshape the terrain, survive changing seasons, and grow your settlement block by block.

games.name: Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator
games.summary: THINK YOU KNOW YOUR ACTION FILMS? Prove it in this easy to use addictive quiz. * Guess a movie from a picture of a key scene.* Guess the action film actors name.* 10 Levels to guess* Auto complete to stop spelling issues* Daily reward hintsOver 200 images to guess from.Tons of fun so download today. All rights, content and trademarks are owned by their respective owners and not associated to fun-apps.

games.name: Table Of Truth
games.summary: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

games.name: TAKEN
games.summary: A first-person found-footage horror FMV game across five chapters. Answer the riddles. Complete the rituals. Satisfy the cult. Eight endings are waiting. Most of them are not escape.

games.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
games.summary: You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb — through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs. Start with one.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: The battle for Hyrule begins. The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Enjoy completely overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, and symphonic orchestral music. You can also jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda™ series.

games.name: The Slormancer
games.summary:
The Slormancer is an epic 2D Action-RPG Dungeon Crawling game following a band of outcasts on their fight against hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer! Play as a "Mighty" Knight, a "Fierce" Huntress or a "Mischievous" Mage, master hundreds of abilities and ancestral powers, gear up, fight for the reputation of your kind and prove your value to the realm.

Featuring loads of shiny Loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

games.name: THE UNREMEMBERED
games.summary: A king is dead with no heir. In a capital where four houses sharpen their blades over an empty throne, you are a wandering mercenary looking for work. Left or right — one swipe decides a life. A dark-fantasy, choice-driven roguelite where, whatever you do, in the end you will not be remembered.

games.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold'em
games.summary: A relaxing single-player six-max No-Limit Texas Hold’em game. Sit down with five AI opponents, each with their own playing style, and enjoy the simple pleasure of betting, reading the table, and making the right call at your own pace.

games.name: TIDEBREAK
games.summary: Wake up on an island the sea swallows a little more every night. Punch trees, craft, build a camp, fish, and hold out against what crawls out of the water. Three bosses, a Beacon, one way home. Solo or with two friends.

games.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup
games.summary: Spick & Span Ltd. is on the job! In this cozy co-op game for 1–8 players, you put wrecked fantasy shops back in order: potions on the shelf, mugs behind the bar, swords on the rack. Take on contracts, earn gold and grow your little magical cleaning company.

games.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
Townworks
games.summary: Townworks is a friendly crafting town builder: design the machines, place your blueprints, and grow a riverside hamlet from crates to home computers. Draw a workshop by hand, belt by belt and arm by arm, then build it all over town.

games.name: Train Simulator: Northampton Loop Route Add-On
Tung Tung Tung Together
games.summary: Tung Tung Tung Together is a co-op (1–4 players) survival horror set 10 years after Tung Tung Tung Survival. On the 1 km × 1 km Little Sahur Island, find items to repair your boat and escape while being hunted by the relentless Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

games.name: Type Me Home
games.summary: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

games.name: UBAI Ending
games.summary: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

games.name: Unpredictable Cake
games.summary: A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

games.name: Valkyrie Tune: Synthesis of Souls
games.summary: A visual novel that brings the "Valkyrie Tune" plastic model series by Good Smile Company to life. Experience the resonant story of an amnesiac protagonist and six stunning heroines, whose intertwining serenade of love, sorrow, and fateful encounters calls forth a reboot for the future.

games.name: Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past
games.summary: A virtual exhibition recreating the first public museum in Lithuania—the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities. Open the doors to the mid-19th century, discover over 100 unique historical exhibits, talk to the founder of the museum himself, and learn about the fate of the collection.

games.name: Von Neumann Project
games.summary: Von Neumann Project is about a self replicating probe as it charts the galaxies, peacefully of course. Mine, build, expand, and explore in this sci-fi RTS. Remember to have as little impact on your surroundings as possible and protect yourself at all costs.

games.name: Wall Punch: Escape The Walls Simulator
games.summary: Break through 50,000 bricks. Time to escape the walls. Punch your way to freedom! Break through walls, punch out the walls and escape prison one punch at a time! Smash through tougher walls, discover new areas, and become the ultimate wall-breaking machine in WALL PUNCH: ESCAPE THE WALLS SIMULATOR

games.name: War Of The Worlds Trilogy
games.summary: Will Earth survive? Experience the Martian invasion from three perspectives. Survive terrifying alien attacks as human, conquer Earth as a Martian, or play the city builder and defend your city against towering Fighting Machines and deadly heat rays. Three games. One war for Earth.

games.name: WASH WASH!
games.summary: From cars to trains and massive ships! Clean it yourself, automate, and grow your own cleaning company!

games.name: Webbound
games.summary: Dive into a minimalist incremental game where you weave luminous webs with tactile string-vibration mechanics. Spare glowing fireflies to enhance your silk, close geometric regions for high-scoring chains, and evolve your modular spider across successive tiers into an apex predator.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: - Fast pace gaming and easy to play- Wonderful graphics- Advanced multipliers mean you get the best wins possible- Auto Hold Feature: Video Poker Classic holds the cards for you! Our finely tuned auto algorithm determines your best chances at success and automatically holds your cards. games.name: Witch Card

games.name: Wretched
games.summary: Wretched is a turn-based tactical game focused on strategic positioning, skill combinations and devastating attacks. Play as an ancient being of immense power. Move into range, kick enemies away and slip behind others. Chain your skills and make every turn count.

games.name: Wrong Mine

Avoid a relentless mechanical spider with electric traps, or betray your crew to claim every reward. Will you work together to survive the dark depths, or leave them behind for the loot?

the twisted spirits that lurk in the darkness.

Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive.

games.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE

games.name: Zeus Evolve Weapons Survivor: Greek Gods Versus Heaven
games.summary:
He built heaven. Now heaven wants him gone. Play as Zeus and survive the war he started!

Olympus has turned on its king.

Endless waves of divine soldiers, mythic beasts, and rival gods close in from every side, and they do not stop.

You are Zeus, the most powerful god in the Greek pantheon, walking alone through the kingdom he built as the sky itself turns against him.

Pick up weapons. Evolve them. Destroy everything.

Can you master the chaos and conquer every track?

Chained Cars is an adrenaline-pumping video game where players control a series of cars linked together by a chain. The goal of the game is to navigate through various obstacles and traps, keeping in mind that all vehicles move simultaneously and must be carefully managed.

As you progress, the difficulty increases, and the tracks become more complex, with new challenges such as moving obstacles, tight corners, and dangerous jumps. The game emphasizes quick reflexes, strategy, and movement coordination to avoid collisions, overcome difficult sections, and go as far as possible.

Features:
-Innovative controls: The cars are linked together, and movements must be carefully coordinated to avoid crashes.
-Challenging tracks: Increasingly difficult levels with dynamic obstacles that require quick thinking and reactions.
-Vibrant graphics: The colorful and detailed design adds extra excitement to the gameplay.
-Progression: Difficulty increases as you advance in the game, with new features and tougher challenges.
-Balance and strategy challenges: Precise control of the cars is essential for success, requiring both skill and careful planning.

In the end, Chained Cars combines speed, strategy, and thrilling challenges, offering an engaging experience for players who enjoy games that push their limits and test their abilities in exciting ways.

Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
games.summary:
The Helion Collection brings together the award-winning Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, which has you living the life of an escaped worker as you attempt to survive on a lawless space station and its sequel, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, a dice-driven RPG where you get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.
About Citizen Sleeper
Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.
About Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.name: Climb the Tsunami Obby
games.summary:
Can you climb your way to the top?

In Climb the Tsunami Obby, parkour your way up a massive tsunami wave while overcoming challenging obstacles and tricky jumps. Reach the top and prove your platforming skills!

With multiple levels, checkpoints, and a Hardcore Mode for those looking for a true challenge, there is always another climb to conquer!

games.name: Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations : The Vow of Hate

games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colourful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Cluedo Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Ice Cream Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

The latest entry in the popular compilation series brings together four fan-favourite Pretty Girls titles in one value-packed retail release, offering players a diverse selection of puzzle and casual gameplay experiences paired with the charming anime-style presentation that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

Each of the four games has been enhanced with exclusive naughty content, that fans of the series have become accustomed to, amounting to a wealth of new images direct from the Japanese creators that would otherwise not have been possible to release on console even in their home country, making this essential and definitive.

games.name: Road Riot: Wild Rides Supporter Pack
Seek
games.summary:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth

Big Jhow Jet

Prepare for takeoff! Strap on your homemade jetpack, defy gravity, and unleash total chaos to save your friends from the dreaded Bacon Factory!

Jhow is a brilliant, tech-obsessed piglet whose peaceful farm life is shattered when an ominous corporate truck kidnaps all his friends.

Refusing to be tomorrow's breakfast, Jhow heads to his secret workshop, fires up his custom-built jetpack, and takes to the skies as the ultimate high-speed hero: Big Jhow Jet!

In this frantic, physics-driven action-arcade game, momentum is everything. Blast out of a cannon and navigate a sky filled with targeted missiles, pigeon bombers, and ground-patrolling Bacon-Bots.

Manage your fuel, bounce off the asphalt, and master aerodynamics to reach maximum velocity.

Out of gas? The run isn't over! Use your last breath to initiate a heroic on-foot Sprint Dash, or rely on crazy power-ups and loyal helpers to keep the flight going!

Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

games.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary:
Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge.

Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt.

games.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
games.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary:
Stardew Valley meets Pokemon! Experience a wholesome farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

You can grow everything from normal crops, berry bushes, and fruit trees, to heart fruit, weird herbs, and mushrooms from other dimensions! From your harvest you can cook high-quality food for your blobs to help them grow healthy and strong.

In the world of Ova Magica, people live side by side with these cute creatures, and you can raise them to be strong, loyal friends and sidekicks! To make your blobs stronger, you must feed them well, pet them and use specific skills in battles.

games.name: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition
games.summary:
RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos.

RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.

SYNERGIZING COINS & CHAOS
Discover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a Multiply Coin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Launch a Nuclear Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!

CRAFT POWERFUL STRATEGIES WITH ITEMS
Stack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos.

DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, DISTINCT PLAYSTYLES
Play as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

games.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
games.summary:
The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
games.summary:
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles. The orchestral soundtrack emphasizes an intimate storyline of unlikely friendship, loss, and love.

Travel across vast, beautifully diverse landscapes, each seamlessly blending into the next, filled with unique flora and fauna waiting to be discovered. The progress you make is reflected in the vibrant flowers blooming on the Golem’s back. There are many secrets and collectibles to discover, making for a rewarding exploration experience.

Solve puzzles that shape the environment around you. Use the Golem’s abilities to interact with the world in creative ways, unlocking new paths and uncovering secrets. Hidden within the remnants of a lost civilization lies the means to reclaim and rejuvenate Nature.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
